content.title: DraftKings Scores As Disney Fumbles ESPN Bet; DKNG Rises
content.summary: Disney ESPN has named DraftKings its official sportsbook and odds provider, effective Dec. 1.  The announcement came after ESPN and Penn Entertainment ended their exclusive ESPN Bet deal early, putting the fate of the sports-betting site in question.  DraftKings' stock bounced early Thursday after hitting a two-year low, with earnings due after the close.
